description: Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 73955/APP/2022/2613 dated 20-03-2023 to allow additional flexibility to use Class B1 employment floorspace for additional uses falling with Class E of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended).
decision_conditions: Condition 2 of planning permission reference 73955/APP/2022/2613 dated 20-03-2023, is amended to:
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans:

To align with the approved plans a further condition has been agreed and is hereby added to the list of conditions accompanying planning permission 73955/APP/2022/2613 as Condition 42 of the permission. The additional condition shall read as follows:

The commercial units at ground floor and mezzanine level, as identified on drawing nos. PL000 Rev P08 and PL000.5 Rev P05 shall only be used for the following purposes falling under the relevant subcategories of Class E of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) as specially referred to on drawing no. PL000 Rev P06 and PL000.5 Rev P05 and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Order:
Unit C1 - Use Classes E(a)(excluding food retail), E(b), E(c) (i, ii and iii), E(d) and E(g)(i)
Units C2, C3 and C4 - Use Classes E(a), E(b), E(c) (I, ii and iii), E(d) and E(g)(i)
To safeguard the amenity of the occupants of the proposed development in accordance with Poli
Accounting for the amendments permitted the description of development for planning permission reference 73955/APP/2022/2613 shall hereby be amended as follows:

"Section 73 application to vary Conditions 2, 3 and 5 of application reference 73955/APP/2021/3362 dated 20-01-2022 (Section 73 application to vary Conditions 2 and 3 of application reference 73955/APP/2020/139 (Demolition of existing buildings for residential-led mixed use development comprising buildings between 3 and 11 storeys to provide residential units (Use Class C3) and commercial floorspace, with associated access and car and cycle parking, landscape and amenity areas and associated servicing) to link internal corridors, relocate the consented gym use, relocate a duplex unit, change duplex units to single level, amend the refuse strategy and amend the layout of the car park & cycle stores) to include a second staircase, reduction in car parking, change to energy strategy, internal flat changes to address fire regulat

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, other than Condition 2 which is superseded by the above condition; and the addition of Condition 42 (restriction of Class E uses) all other conditions relating to planning permission reference 73955/APP/2022/2613 dated 20-03-2023 must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
